import { Icon } from "@astrojs/starlight/components";

Below the list of rules supported by Biome, divided by group. Here's a legend of the emojis:
- The icon <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is recommended"><Icon name="approve-check-circle" label="This rule is recommended" /></span> indicates that the rule is part of the recommended rules.
- The icon <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule has a safe fix"><Icon name="seti:config" label="The rule has a safe fix" /></span> indicates that the rule provides a code action (fix) that is **safe** to apply.
- The icon <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule has an unsafe fix"><Icon name="warning" label="The rule has an unsafe fix" /></span> indicates that the rule provides a code action (fix) that is **unsafe** to apply.
- The icon <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is not released yet"><Icon name="moon" label="This rule is not released yet" /></span> indicates that the rule has been implemented and scheduled for the next release.

## `correctness`

| Rule name | Description | Properties |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [noDuplicateArgumentNames](/linter/rules/no-duplicate-argument-names/graphql) | Require unique argument names for fields and directives. | <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is recommended" ><Icon name="approve-check-circle" size="1.2rem" label="This rule is recommended" /></span> |
| [noDuplicateEnumValueNames](/linter/rules/no-duplicate-enum-value-names/graphql) | Disallow duplicate names in GraphQL enums. | <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is recommended" ><Icon name="approve-check-circle" size="1.2rem" label="This rule is recommended" /></span> |
| [noDuplicateFieldDefinitionNames](/linter/rules/no-duplicate-field-definition-names/graphql) | Require all fields of a type to be unique. | <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is recommended" ><Icon name="approve-check-circle" size="1.2rem" label="This rule is recommended" /></span> |
| [noDuplicateInputFieldNames](/linter/rules/no-duplicate-input-field-names/graphql) | Require fields within an input object to be unique. | <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is recommended" ><Icon name="approve-check-circle" size="1.2rem" label="This rule is recommended" /></span> |
| [noDuplicateVariableNames](/linter/rules/no-duplicate-variable-names/graphql) | Require all variable definitions to be unique. | <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is recommended" ><Icon name="approve-check-circle" size="1.2rem" label="This rule is recommended" /></span> |
| [useGraphqlNamedOperations](/linter/rules/use-graphql-named-operations/graphql) | Require a name for every explicit GraphQL operation definition. | <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is recommended" ><Icon name="approve-check-circle" size="1.2rem" label="This rule is recommended" /></span><span class='inline-icon' title="The rule has an unsafe fix" ><Icon name="warning" label="The rule has an unsafe fix" size="1.2rem" /></span> |
| [useLoneAnonymousOperation](/linter/rules/use-lone-anonymous-operation/graphql) | Disallow an anonymous operation in a document with other operations. | <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is recommended" ><Icon name="approve-check-circle" size="1.2rem" label="This rule is recommended" /></span> |

## `style`

| Rule name | Description | Properties |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [noExcessiveLinesPerFile](/linter/rules/no-excessive-lines-per-file/graphql) | Restrict the number of lines in a file. |  |
| [noRootType](/linter/rules/no-root-type/graphql) | Disallow configured GraphQL root operation types. |  |
| [useConsistentGraphqlDescriptions](/linter/rules/use-consistent-graphql-descriptions/graphql) | Require one description style throughout a GraphQL schema. |  |
| [useDeprecatedReason](/linter/rules/use-deprecated-reason/graphql) | Require a reason when using the `@deprecated` directive. | <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is recommended" ><Icon name="approve-check-circle" size="1.2rem" label="This rule is recommended" /></span> |
| [useGraphqlNamingConvention](/linter/rules/use-graphql-naming-convention/graphql) | Require uppercase names for GraphQL enum values. |  |
| [useInputName](/linter/rules/use-input-name/graphql) | Require mutation arguments to be named `input`. |  |
| [useLoneExecutableDefinition](/linter/rules/use-lone-executable-definition/graphql) | Require one executable GraphQL definition per file. |  |

## `suspicious`

| Rule name | Description | Properties |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [noDuplicateFields](/linter/rules/no-duplicate-fields/graphql) | Disallow duplicate names inside GraphQL operations. | <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is recommended" ><Icon name="approve-check-circle" size="1.2rem" label="This rule is recommended" /></span> |
| [noDuplicateGraphqlOperationName](/linter/rules/no-duplicate-graphql-operation-name/graphql) | Require unique operation names within a GraphQL document. |  |
| [noEmptySource](/linter/rules/no-empty-source/graphql) | Disallow empty sources. |  |
| [useDeprecatedDate](/linter/rules/use-deprecated-date/graphql) | Require a valid deletion date on the `@deprecated` directive. |  |
